findings.title: Clean up lifecycle resources when eager initialization fails
findings.body: If `s.Init` fails after `s.lifecycle.Init` has succeeded—for example, while building the search index—this returns `nil` without calling `s.cancel()` or `s.lifecycle.Stop`. The caller receives no server to stop, so initialized backend resources and any background work they started can be left running, potentially interfering with retries or shutdown.
